rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard DFT application (OPBE/TZVP) with transition metals. While evaluating multiple spin states and extracting planarity adds minor complexity, it remains an off-the-shelf computational chemistry procedure. No novel derivations or custom algorithms.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a few sequential stages: generating initial geometries, running ORCA (a well-established external tool) for each metal/spin, and then parsing logs to populate four CSV files. No fragile handoffs or complex orchestration beyond executing a standard computational chemistry code.

No novel algorithms or deep conceptual hurdles are involved. The pipeline is multi-step but straightforward: build models, run ORCA, extract data from outputs.
